authorization.request: Manually rescan all known DSH plugin records without triggering a scheduled bulk scan; admit qualifying plugins only through the dedicated one-time policy workflow, while scheduled policy continues reviewing Catalog entries.
authorization.githubCredential: GitHub App connector for the repair PR; workflow_dispatch uses the authenticated UI and the policy job uses its short-lived Actions token.

change.description: Pass the already validated Candidate Registry into inspectManualAdmissions so the selected fixed-source set is checked against the official latest-three compatibility policy without relying on an out-of-scope binding.
boundaries: The manual policy path reads only the three selected immutable source Commits and disables scheduled discovery, historical Catalog rescans, author notifications, and owner reports.
The scheduled workflow remains unchanged and continues to review the existing Catalog entries.
No third-party install, prepare, build, test, or runtime code is executed.
Candidate and community registries are not mutated by the manual admission path.

deterministicGates.required: MANUAL_DSH_SCAN_PLAN_OK for all 26,870 completed targets and exactly three source-verified selections.
Registry validation and all tests pass.
No whitespace errors and exact planned file scope.
The exact PR head has all required CI checks passing, and the merged GitHub commit reports verification.verified=true.
Dispatch the exact manual scan plan branch and commit once; require a fresh Catalog policy plan, fixed-Commit source recheck, official latest-three compatibility, and an auditable Catalog PR.

mutation.commit: One atomic GitHub-generated signed commit on an isolated PR branch; no direct main mutation.
mutation.backup: The original main Commit and files remain recoverable through Git history.
mutation.rollback: Revert the repair through a new CI-checked, signed PR. Do not rewrite the contact ledger or restore the defective manual admission path.

healthCheck: All repository checks and exact-head PR CI pass; after merge, the one-time policy workflow either opens a fresh Catalog PR for currently eligible fixed Commits or records a fail-closed outcome. Verify merged Catalog and public storefronts separately.
nonGoals: No changes to periodic discovery cadence or existing Catalog review scope.
No third-party execution, author outreach, DSH Profile changes, or runtime installation.
